conclusion: Happy path works; governed enforcement, recovery and reusable lifecycle/conformance are incomplete.

findings.title: Central apply bypasses the shared construction gate
findings.evidence: The central CLI committed a real signed proposal in a disposable native store with no construction packet. The alternate Python delegation route remains available through lab.mjs and workspace dispatch.
findings.required_change: Route central effects through the shared guard, or explicitly restrict legacy apply to an isolated compatibility surface. Add a valid-signed-proposal bypass regression.

findings.title: Canonical registry changes are not closed over native signed targets
findings.evidence: The isolated publisher accepted a 193-entry registry omitting the signed Definition Pack target, while all five native Definition targets and their original bodies remained in the snapshot. Only registry/index/change membership was reduced. A temporary signer and database were used.
findings.required_change: Compare exact semantic registry deltas, native effects and owner-reviewed targets. Every required admitted target must appear; every added/changed entry must have its corresponding authorized native effect.
findings.basis: reproduced omission; inverse check absent in inspected source

findings.title: Registry/v2 does not preserve or authenticate retained owner-disposition provenance
findings.evidence: Registry assessment accepted an unchanged real v2 body after its owner_disposition was replaced with a missing-owner.json binding, zero digest and no supplied artifact. No change was approved. Original decision checking applies only to legacy entries with admission_decision_ref.
findings.required_change: Resolve and authenticate all original dispositions and preserve complete binding identity across v2 snapshots. Require an explicit authorized transition for changes.

findings.title: Source transition relabels old review evidence instead of deriving compatibility
findings.evidence: All five current transition review projections declare cut 85a15a..., but the referenced exact owner-disposition artifacts declare original cut 655e13.... The recursive recut function replaces strings and reseals the result. The real owner acceptances remain valid records; this procedure does not establish freshly verified current-cut facts.
findings.required_change: Preserve original receipts and cuts. Observe current source/authority facts and issue explicit carry-forward or revalidation evidence bound to both cuts and full original artifacts.
findings.basis: verified against current persisted requests and original owner artifacts

findings.title: Approved implementation identity is not an execution precondition
findings.evidence: The kernel builds and evaluates the current on-disk AlchLang fingerprint. Activation reads status and paths but does not check admitted implementation-manifest hashes. Receipts bind a native source cut, not the executed AlchLang implementation digest. Current files do match the recorded manifest; the missing enforcement affects subsequent edits.
findings.required_change: Bind the approved implementation/source/profile digest into activation, operation receipts and historical replay. Refuse unselected changes before effects.
findings.basis: source inspection; live code was not modified to exercise drift

findings.title: Publication replay trusts corrupt stored receipt metadata
findings.evidence: On a copied database, setting the stored publication receipt selected.digest to 64 zeroes was returned as a successful replay of the authentic original request.
findings.required_change: Verify complete request/receipt identity, manifest, workspace/operation and selector history before returning replay or inspection success.

findings.title: Join replay does not verify retained authentication evidence
findings.evidence: On a copied journal, clearing every commands.evidence value to an empty object still yielded a valid Completed run with ten events. Inspection checks artifact checksums and receipt continuity, but never validates the stored evidence column.
findings.required_change: Bind full evidence into journal events and reauthenticate original artifacts and context during recovery. Retain the original source/policy selection needed for historical replay.

findings.title: Unchanged successor lineage blocks later publication
findings.evidence: The unchanged-entry branch requires predecessor to be null. A focused case with identical previous/proposed entries and an existing non-null predecessor is rejected as registry-unapproved-lifecycle-change. After a legitimate successor publication, this would block unrelated subsequent publication.
findings.required_change: Preserve the exact previous predecessor binding for v2-to-v2 snapshots. Restrict null requirements to the migration cases that require them. Add upgrade followed by unrelated publication coverage.
findings.basis: reproduced early rejection; full upgrade sequence not executed

findings.title: Reusable impact and independent conformance ports lack active qualification
findings.evidence: The active trust has zero materials and zero executors. Impact needs trust.materials; assess needs trust.executors. Isolated tests supply fixture qualification, while the active repository has none. Direct activation validators do not establish reusable port readiness.
findings.required_change: Qualify the actual consumer universe/materials and independent executable/specification/fixture/output bindings. Run a real lifecycle and generation-completion journey through the installed ports.

findings.title: Activation does not establish or restore resource readiness
findings.evidence: The activation script validates tracked JSON and recorded publication metadata, then writes active status. It neither checks the selected live SQLite/native state nor restores it. After loss of local state or on a fresh checkout it can report active while default commands cannot run. Current host resources do exist and pass live checks.
findings.required_change: Separate admitted selection from operational readiness. Restore/reconcile verified resources through a supported path, or refuse activation until the exact stores and selector are verified. Keep private keys untracked.
findings.basis: source inspection; live state was not removed

scope: Code and live authority/stores unchanged. Test commits/publications occurred only in disposable stores with temporary keys or copied databases. Existing 399 checks were inspected, not rerun wholesale.
